changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led, two-Crew incident investigation and verified recovery proposal.

title: Incident to Verified Recovery
description: Coordinate an incident investigation, an owned fix or rollback decision, and evidence that the affected service recovered.
setup_prompt: Use Incident to Verified Recovery as a proposal. Inspect existing Crews and the customer's incident, telemetry, issue, CI, deploy, and status sources. Propose reuse or creation of Incident Investigator and Engineering Delivery Coordinator, a bounded incident-to-change handoff, owner review before any remediation, a manual first run, and a recovery evidence rule. Show the concrete plan before configuring it with Builder tools. Selecting this Playbook does not create Crews, change production, send messages, close an incident, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Affected service, incident ID, time window, and timezone
Authorized incident, telemetry, issue, CI, and deployment records or exports
On-call and release owners, escalation and change policies
Service recovery indicators and observation window
Manual-only or reviewed trigger and notification route

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create a reviewed missing Engineering Crew with a stable idempotency key

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated bounded incident artifact between authorized Crews

recommended_tools.name: Incident manager or bounded export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read incident ID, ownership, timeline, and current state

recommended_tools.name: Monitoring, logs, or bounded export
recommended_tools.purpose: Check impact and service recovery evidence

recommended_tools.name: Issue, CI, and deployment records or exports
recommended_tools.purpose: Trace the reviewed remediation to its actual environment

pulse_focus.label: Incident recovery follow-through
focus_areas: Whether incident actions have owners and verified completion
Whether the affected service met the agreed recovery rule
review_when: A new incident appears, owner action stalls, deployment state changes, or recovery evidence changes

outputs: Reviewed Engineering Crew roster and source map
Service recovery evidence and closure decision
